ImportDocumentType.description: Kind of paperwork this file represents.

fileId.description: The `import_account_files` row (supplier invoice) this line came from.

lineIndex.description: Position of the line inside that file's `lineItems`.

item.description: Item / part / model code as printed (may contain spaces).

price.description: Unit price with the currency mark stripped.

total.description: Line total with the currency mark stripped.

classification.description: What the classification screen recorded; empty defaults when never classified.

id.description: Id of the `import_account_files` row created for this file.

documentType.description: Kind of paperwork this file represents.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the storage root (`storage/` at the repo root).

lineItems.description: Goods lines extracted from the file. Only present for SUPPLIER_INVOICE; empty when nothing could be extracted (see `extractionError`).

extractionError.description: Why `lineItems` is empty: unreadable file, unsupported type or no table. Absent when extraction succeeded or was not attempted.

fileId.description: The `import_account_files` row (supplier invoice) the line belongs to.
